title: Revered NASA spacecraft is about to perish in flames — astronomers are mourning
title_zh: 备受尊崇的 NASA 航天器即将在火焰中毁灭，天文学家正在哀悼
abstract: A failed rescue mission means that the Swift observatory will fall into Earth’s atmosphere next week, but it leaves behind a massive archive of data for scientists to explore.
abstract_zh: 一次失败的救援任务意味着 Swift 观测站将于下周坠入地球大气层，但它为科学家留下了可供探索的大量数据档案。
snippet: A failed rescue mission means that the Swift observatory will fall into Earth’s atmosphere next week, but it leaves behind a massive archive of data for scientists to explore.
